The '''Trade Federation Tug''' was a type of [[Spacetug/Legends|tug]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]].

==Characteristics==
The tug was propelled by two [[Engine/Legends|engines]] and equipped with [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to move objects. It also sported a dorsal fin similar to that of the [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]].

==History==
The [[Sabaoth destroyer]] [[Reaver (Sabaoth destroyer)|''Reaver'']] carried a number of Trade Federation Tugs to [[Nod Kartha]] after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was attacked by the combined [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] forces of the [[Mere Resistance]] and the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]]. A tug was launched to recover the barrel of an [[Orbital Defense Cannon]], but it was destroyed by [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], leader of the Lok Revenants. More tugs were launched to recover the barrel and capture other [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] parts. The pirates kept the Trade Federation Tugs from getting any cannon parts while their [[Mere Tug|own tugs]] took the parts to the [[Mere cruiser]] ''[[Tritus]]''.
